title: VtM5e Clans
description: Standalone, complete Clan compendium (all 16: 14 major clans + Caitiff + Thin-Blooded). Originally covered only the 7 clans the V5 corebook doesn't ship (from the Player's Guide); expanded to the full roster so this module is the sole, authoritative Clan source for chargen and no longer depends on the community compendium's own Clan pack. Not published; built for personal use.
